Description:
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#a61c00][size=5]Rip (and tear) in the Valley[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#a61c00]A Doom-inspired NPC[/color][/b]
[size=4][i]He came through a portal from the battlefields of Hell.[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]He found Pelican Town, friendship, and chickens.[/i][/size]
[/center]
[center]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/center]
[size=4][b][color=#b22222]About the Mod[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]An experiment in the Wizard’s tower has an unexpected outcome.
Instead of opening a harmless window between worlds, they pull a heavily armored warrior from another dimension into Stardew Valley.[/size]
[size=4]
Stranded far from home, Rip establishes a fortified camp near the mines and begins investigating the valley’s monsters. Unfortunately, he is considerably less prepared for its chickens, fishing traditions, baked goods, small-town politics, and aggressively friendly residents.[/size]
[size=4]
Befriend Rip as he adjusts to life in Pelican Town, helps defend the valley, and begins to question whether returning home is really what he wants. [/size]

[size=4]He'll learn that maybe it's not about the demons we slay, but the chickens we meet along the way.[/size]

[size=4][b][color=#b22222]Meet Rip[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Rip is a quiet, armored warrior from a world consumed by endless war with the hordes of hell.[/size]
[size=4]
He is not romanceable, but he can be befriended up to ten hearts. As your friendship develops, Rip gradually becomes more comfortable around the residents of the valley—and begins discovering that not every problem needs to be solved with overwhelming firepower. Although overwhelming firepower still works surprisingly often. [/size]

[size=4]Rip follows a custom daily schedule that takes him between his camp, the mines, the Adventurer’s Guild, Pelican Town, Marnie’s Ranch, and the Stardrop Saloon.[/size]

[color=#900000][b][size=5]FAQ[/size][/b][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]Q. [i]Did you use AI in this mod?[/i][/size][/color]
[size=4]A. [i]No. fellowclown made Rip's sprites and I made all the art by hand and no AI was used to code.[/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Is this mod compatible with...?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. Probably[/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Hey, you know what would be cool?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. No, tell me. Maybe I can make it happen. [/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. I'm having an issue with...[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. Send me your log and I promise to try to fix it. [/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Are you going to make him romanceable?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. No. Doomguy only knows the thrill of blood lust. [/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Is this compatible with mutliplayer?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. I mean it should be fine but I have not tested this. Take one for the team and let me know. [/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Can this be installed mid-save?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. Yes[/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Where is Rip's camp?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. Go into the Mines entrance and you'll see a path next to the elevator. [/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Can I translate this mod?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. A rose by any other name would smell just as sweet (yes).[/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Is this compatible with Android?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. No sorry I don't know how to do that yet. [/i][/size]

[size=4][i]Q. Is this compatible with Mac OS?[/i][/size]
[size=4][i]A. I have no idea. Probably not. The most likely issue will be the fish not rendering correctly. [/i][/size]
